component.name: Sony Device Center
component.summary: Modern companion application and SDK for Sony audio devices

description.p: Sony Device Center provides complete control over Sony Bluetooth headphones and earbuds including the WH-1000XM5, WH-1000XM4, WH-1000XM3, LinkBuds S, and WH-CH720N.

ul.li: Active Noise Cancellation and Ambient Sound control
Equalizer customization and Clear Bass tuning
Background daemon with socket IPC and CLI utility

description.p: Sony Device Center is an independent open-source project, free for anyone to use, study and modify. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Sony Corporation. Sony and all product names are trademarks of their respective owners. The app talks to the headphones over a reverse-engineered protocol, for interoperability.
